item.name: Fenway Drive
item.cardSummary: A small suburban listing flagged by a worried real estate agent, and one of the three starter homes available from the very beginning.
item.notes: One of the original launch job sites, unlocked from the start with no level requirement. A compact single-family home that suits quick, low-risk investigations and early money runs.

item.name: Juniper Road
item.cardSummary: A small reported-haunting house and one of the tightest maps in the game, making it a popular pick for fast, efficient runs.
item.notes: A launch job site available from the start. Its small, compact layout means short walking distances between rooms, which is why many players favor it for quick investigations.

item.name: Lincoln Street
item.cardSummary: A small family home with a basement, called in by residents reporting paranormal activity, available from the start of the game.
item.notes: An original launch job site unlocked from the start. Unlike the other starter homes it includes a basement level, giving it more spawn areas to search despite its small footprint.

item.name: Bodega
item.cardSummary: An NYC corner-store bodega reported for ghostly activity, the only small job site themed as a shop rather than a home.
item.notes: A later small job site set in a New York-style corner store with a store floor plus back and upper rooms. It is the only non-residential small map and unlocks once the player reaches the required level.

item.name: Lilim Lane
item.cardSummary: A traditional two-story Filipino home reported as haunted by its architect, the first medium-sized job site to unlock.
item.notes: The earliest medium job site, themed as a traditional Filipino house spread over two floors with foyer, bedrooms, and an office. It is the natural step up once players outgrow the starter homes.

item.name: Cafe
item.cardSummary: HVNLY Coffee, a medium two-floor cafe where customers were harmed by flying furniture, mixing public dining areas with back-of-house rooms.
item.notes: A medium job site set in a coffee shop with a ground-floor coffee bar and an upper dining area plus staff rooms, an alley, and an office. Its mix of open and tight rooms makes for a varied search.

item.name: Bridgewood Drive
item.cardSummary: A high-end forest mansion reported by a wealthy client, a multi-story medium job site that is one of the larger homes in the medium tier.
item.notes: A medium job site themed as a forest mansion, with a garage, den, multiple bedrooms, and bathrooms across more than one floor. It carries one of the higher unlock requirements in the medium tier.

item.name: Oakbridge Estates
item.cardSummary: A multi-unit estate where a haunting was reported with an unknown origin, the newest and highest-unlock medium job site.
item.notes: A recent medium job site built as a cluster of estate units (rooms grouped under numbers like 561, 562, and 563), giving it a sprawling, repeated-layout feel. It has the highest unlock level of any medium map.

item.name: Prison
item.cardSummary: A shut-down state prison where a ghost caused several injuries, the first large job site players unlock.
item.notes: An original launch job site and the entry point into the large tier, with cells, a courtyard, an infirmary, kitchen, and library spread across multiple areas. Its long corridors make for a slower, more demanding search.

item.name: School
item.cardSummary: A school where students were hurt by objects thrown by nothing, a large multi-floor job site full of classrooms and offices.
item.notes: A large job site with classrooms, a cafeteria, library, common rooms, and offices across two floors. The many similar rooms and long hallways make it one of the more time-consuming maps to clear.

item.name: Asylum
item.cardSummary: A 20th-century lunatic asylum long rumored to be haunted, the largest job site in the game with the highest unlock level.
item.notes: The biggest job site in Demonology, themed as an old asylum with therapy rooms, an X-ray lab, sleeping halls, and a basement across multiple floors. Its size and high unlock level make it a late-game challenge.
